author: Seung Wook
problem: Read a string S of lowercase letters with length 1, 2 or 3, and print the string of length 6 formed by repeating S.
bug_description: The repeat count loop is range(6) instead of range(7), so a one-character S (which needs 6 copies) prints nothing.

comments.accurate: Repeats S the number of times needed to reach exactly 6 characters and prints it
comments.wrong_behavior: Tries repeat counts below 6 and prints the first that gives 6 characters
comments.wrong_location: Repeat-count range verified; check the length test against strings with trailing whitespace
